mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_article_favorite (user_id, article_id, created) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, #{created})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_article_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_article_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT af.*, u.username, u.email, a.title FROM t_article_favorite af LEFT JOIN t_user u ON af.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_article a ON af.article_id = a.id WHERE af.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY af.created DESC

SELECT af.*, u.username, u.email, a.title, a.content, a.created as article_created, a.categories, a.tags, a.thumbnail FROM t_article_favorite af LEFT JOIN t_user u ON af.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_article a ON af.article_id = a.id WHERE af.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY af.created DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_article_favorite WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_article_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}
